title: 60 rolls of a die
caption: A fair die would give 10 of each face. The observed counts 8, 9, 12, 11, 6, 14 differ from 10 by −2, −1, 2, 1, −4, 4, so χ² = (4 + 1 + 4 + 1 + 16 + 16)/10 = 4.2, below 11.07: no evidence of bias.
alt: Bar chart of the face counts 8, 9, 12, 11, 6 and 14 for faces 1 to 6.
description: The expected count for each face is 60/6 = 10.
Squared differences from 10 are 4, 1, 4, 1, 16, 16, which sum to 42.
χ² = 42/10 = 4.2, less than the critical value 11.07.
